duration: 5 days, the last week of July
name: CampMed (free summer health camp)
what_you_do: Spend 5 days on campus. You practice hands-on health care skills like CPR, stitching and head-to-toe exams. You also explore careers with RFU graduate students in medicine, pharmacy, nursing and physical therapy.
who_can_apply: Lake County high school students who like health care, science and research.
deadline_text: The page gives no application dates. The camp runs during the last week of July.
how_to_apply: Email campmed@rfums.org to ask how to apply.
notes: In person only. Ask when applications open.
org: Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine and Science
